risks.risk: The camera body may be missing, a different model, or a non-functional shell.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera body showing the model name and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic non-working unit for parts

risks.risk: The image sensor may have scratches, fungus, or dead pixels.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the lens or body cap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a costly sensor replacement

risks.risk: The shutter may have a very high actuation count, nearing its mechanical limit.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from the most recent image's metadata.
risks.if_unproven: as a heavily used unit with low remaining life

proof_requests: Clear photos of the camera body from all angles (front, back, top, bottom).
A photo of the camera sensor with the body cap removed.
A photo of the rear LCD screen while the camera is powered on.
A screenshot or report of the current shutter count.
response.reason: The seller has only provided photos of the packaging and manuals. The actual camera body is wrapped in bubble wrap and cannot be inspected for condition, authenticity, or functionality.
